title: FactRefreshPlan
description: The plan for WHEN and HOW a verified fact should be re-checked — the bridge from a VerificationRecipe into the cost ladder's watch rungs (M5). It names the fact_key + the verification_recipe_id that will be re-run, the watch_mode that triggers it, and the next_check_at horizon (computed from a refresh cadence over an INJECTED last_verified_at — no wall-clock). It is a schedule of work, not a fact: refreshing produces a new FactVerificationRun, it does not itself serve truth. In the lean core the scheduler is DEFERRED; this plan is the contract MAIN's scheduler will read. Deterministic when last_verified_at + planned_at are injected.

plan_id.description: content-addressed over (fact_key, verification_recipe_id, watch_mode); version in metadata, never in the id

verification_recipe_id.description: the VerificationRecipe re-run on each refresh (lineage)

volatility_class.description: drives the refresh cadence (a deadline/rate fact refreshes more often)

last_verified_at.description: INJECTED epoch seconds of the last successful verification (no wall-clock)

next_check_at.description: computed = last_verified_at + refresh_interval_seconds (deterministic over injected time); 0 for no_refresh

max_staleness_seconds.description: after this a cached fact is treated as stale and must not be served as current

produces.description: pinned — a refresh produces a FactVerificationRun, never directly a served/canonical fact
